title: Affine target Leray comparison for the module cohomology unit map
statement: Let f:X -> S be qcqs, g:S prime -> S any morphism, and F a quasi-coherent module. Let I,J,V,W,hV,hW,eVW and D be the resolutions, affine opens, containment and restricted-resolution choices [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Assume the supplied A-algebra structure on B has algebraMap equal to the canonical section map g.appLE(V,W,eVW). Set A=Gamma(S,V), B=Gamma(S prime,W), h:f inverse V -> Spec A, N=pullback of F to f inverse V, T=(f inverse V)_B, M=N_B, and Q=R^p f prime_*(g prime tensor pullback F) [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. For any family E of additive equivalences from module derived sections to H on T, natural for every module morphism, there is a B-linear equivalence b:HOver(h_B,M,p) -> Gamma(Q,W). For every module cohomology class x of F restricted to f inverse V, apply module cohomology to the canonical restriction/pullback coefficient isomorphism, then apply the module cohomology h-map of baseChangeUnit, then E at M and b. The result equals restriction to W of D.targetClass(moduleCohomologyFMap(D.psi)(x)) [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. No source E is supplied or constructed; H.baseChangeLinear does not occur in the statement. This is the chart/unit and normalized Leray part of the argument, before comparing module and Ext pullbacks.

proof.text: Obtain the chart additive equivalence t with its scalar and unit equations, and the affine target additive equivalence d with its scalar and restriction equations. These constructions do not use the arbitrary natural Ext coordinates E.

Compose E at the chart coefficient inverse, t, and d to form bAdd. Apply E naturality to the scalar endomorphism to obtain the scalar equation for E inverse. Combine this with t and d scalar equations to form a linear map; its underlying additive equivalence makes it bijective, so LinearEquiv.ofBijective gives b.

On a source class, cancel E inverse composed with E. Then apply the chart unit equation and the target edge restriction equation in succession. Their transitive equality is precisely the required formula.

theorem exists_flatBaseChange_module_leray_comparison
    {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (p : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (eVW : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (D : Scheme.Modules.FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V)
    [Algebra Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W)]
    (hAlgebra : algebraMap Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W) = (g.appLE V W eVW).hom) :
    let h := f.resLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl ≫ V.toSpecΓ
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F
    let Q := ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst g f)).rightDerived p).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F)
    ∀ E : ∀ M : (baseChangedScheme (S := Γ(S', W)) h).Modules,
        ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
          (baseChangedScheme (S := Γ(S', W)) h).toRingedSpace p).obj M) ≃+ H M p,
      (∀ (M M' : (baseChangedScheme (S := Γ(S', W)) h).Modules) (φ : M ⟶ M')
        (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
          (baseChangedScheme (S := Γ(S', W)) h).toRingedSpace p).obj M),
        E M' (((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
          (baseChangedScheme (S := Γ(S', W)) h).toRingedSpace p).map φ).hom x) =
          H.map φ p (E M x)) →
      ∃ b : HOver (baseChangeSnd (S := Γ(S', W)) h)
          (baseChangedModule (S := Γ(S', W)) h N) p ≃ₗ[Γ(S', W)] Γ(Q, W),
        ∀ x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
          (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
            ((restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F),
          b (E (baseChangedModule (S := Γ(S', W)) h N)
            (moduleCohomologyFMap (baseChangeFst (S := Γ(S', W)) h)
              (baseChangeUnit (S := Γ(S', W)) h N) p
              (((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).map
                ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).app F).hom).hom x))) =
            Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE eVW).op
              (D.targetClass p
                (moduleCohomologyFMap ((pullback.snd g f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
                  ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl) D.psi p x))
